metadata.title: Does teachers’ motivation have an impact on students’ scientific literacy and motivation? An empirical study in Colombia with data from PISA 2015

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used all ten plausible values for science and applied Rubin's rules for analysis.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly applied the final school weights at level two in the multilevel modeling framework.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study utilized a multilevel modeling framework, which accounts for the clustering of students within schools.
design_fields.q4_rationale: There is no mention of any validation strategy beyond the estimation sample in the provided excerpts.
